translations.web: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.” ’
translations.bsb: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
translations.kjv: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
